name: Unscripted Living
overview: CHU Feng-hsia loves indulging in gourmet food after filming; it is the most healing moment of her day. Dissatisfied with her birth name, she much prefers her stage name, CHU Jo-lan. Her perfectionism, however, frequently leaves her grappling with intense anxiety and pressure. While working on the film Primrose, she encountered overwhelming difficulties and ultimately decided to withdraw from the project. Although she once had a happy marriage, she could not bridge the gap as she and her husband drifted apart. Following her divorce, she began to focus on herself—yet, whether in her personal life or her career, she finds herself facing obstacles once again.
